title: Portia Paper Interpretation
description: Version-1 immutable operational staging record for one interpretation generation of one Portia Page Record. It preserves exact historical layout identity, interpreter/mapping identity, page-local entry slots, mechanical candidate literals, deterministic normalized candidates, and uncertainty. It is not a human review, accepted evidence, source truth, canonical behavior-domain record, or authorization to materialize one.
$comment: Application validation must resolve the exact Capture Batch, Page Target, Page Record, Core-retained source lineage, and historical capture specification; enforce idempotency and generation history; validate entry/field keys against the exact capture specification; preserve uncertainty; and prevent machine candidates, confidence, mapped record kinds, or normalized values from bypassing attributable human review where review is required. Raw scan/PDF bytes remain Core-owned and are never embedded here.

x-portia-application-invariants.description: class_id/work_id/page_target_id/page_record_id must resolve to one exact Page Record and its exact Capture Batch/Page Target lineage; interpretation never retargets a returned page.
layout_snapshot must exactly match the historical Page Target template/layout/capture-spec identity and fingerprint; current-installed-template substitution is prohibited.

Every entry map key must be declared by the exact Page Target entry_layout; omission/presence semantics must follow the exact historical capture specification rather than scan order or array position.
Every field map key and optional region_key must be valid for the entry in the exact historical capture specification; field/region keys are page-local locators, not person or domain-record identity.
Reprocessing the same Page Record with the same interpreter_profile must reuse the same logical interpretation generation rather than create duplicate candidate history or downstream records.
A changed interpreter version, mapping profile/version, or other contract-significant interpretation profile creates a new preserved generation; it never silently rewrites an earlier generation.

Once persisted, candidate literals, normalized values, uncertainty states, layout snapshot, profile identity, and entry/field mappings are immutable; correction or reinterpretation creates a later generation.

blank, unmarked, unreadable, and ambiguous are distinct source states and must not be converted into false, no, declined, absent, uninvolved, unsuccessful, or another domain value merely to satisfy a downstream schema.

candidate_detected and ambiguous alternatives are machine/manual staging candidates only; candidate literal or normalized values are not human-confirmed values and may be corrected, rejected, or left unresolved later.
Confidence may prioritize review but cannot establish truth, identity, authorship, credibility, participation, judgment, or eligibility and cannot bypass required human review.

mapped_record_kind, when present, must come from the exact historical mapping profile/template purpose rather than inference from narrative or detected marks; it describes a possible target family only and does not authorize record creation.

Interpretation must not fuzzy-match people, infer source authorship/firsthand status, Event participation/fault, Classification/Hypothesis/Determination, Response appropriateness, Support recommendation, Fidelity, Outcome, recurrence failure, Reentry/Repair completion, remorse, forgiveness, or comparable human judgment.
Persisting a complete or partial interpretation must not create, activate, complete, invalidate, supersede, or otherwise mutate any canonical behavior-domain record.
Raw scan/PDF/image bytes and temporary scanner paths remain outside Paper Interpretation JSON; exact source history is reached through the Page Record and Core retained-source provenance.

generation.description: Positive immutable interpretation generation within the Page Record lineage. Generation ordering is operational history only and never establishes semantic correctness.

interpretation_status.description: Mechanical processing coverage only. complete means the configured historical regions were processed; it does not mean values are correct, human-reviewed, or accepted.

limitation_codes.description: Privacy-minimized processing limitations. Codes describe interpretation coverage, not behavior-domain conclusions.

interpreted_by.description: Agent that produced this staging interpretation. Human local-operator transcription here is still not the later attributable confirmation/review decision.

interpreter_id.description: Stable local interpreter/engine/procedure identifier. It does not identify a human source or establish authority.

entryMap.description: Map keyed by stable Page Target entry_key. Object keys provide minimal page-local entry identity without introducing globally opaque entry IDs.

entry_state.description: Mechanical slot-level interpretation state. blank does not mean false/no; unreadable is distinct from blank; candidate only means field-level staging information is present.

mapped_record_kind.description: Optional exact mapping-profile target family. It does not assert that a canonical record exists, should be created, or is semantically valid.

fieldMap.description: Map keyed by stable capture-spec field_key. Keys are page-local layout locators and never person or canonical-record identifiers.

region_key.description: Optional smallest capture-spec-local region locator when field_key alone is insufficient.

candidate_literal.description: Literal nonblank transcription/detection candidate as emitted by the interpreter. It is not silently polished, normalized, quoted as human-confirmed wording, or treated as true.

normalized_value.description: Optional deterministic normalized candidate. The literal candidate remains preserved and normalization does not establish correctness or domain meaning.

confidence.description: Interpreter-supplied confidence/score for review prioritization only; not truth probability, credibility, authority, or a review bypass.
